identity.title: ALMA 0.88 mm Survey of Disks around Planetary-mass Companions

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report ALMA 0.88 mm (Band 7) continuum observations of six planetary-mass (10–20 $M_{\rm Jup}$) companions

question.value: Do disks around planetary-mass companions follow the disk flux-host mass trend of stellar disks, or are they fainter (e.g., like binary-star disks)?

evidence.quote: it is not clear whether disks around planetary-mass companions indeed follow the disk flux-host mass trend in the stellar regime.
ALMA Cycle 4 program #2016.1.01018.S; PI: B. Bowler
we performed the survey in Band 7 instead of Band 6 (1.3 mm)
